mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature at Verona Community Park is 72 degrees with clear skies. We are currently under a third quarter moon, and there is a visible pass of the International Space Station early this morning. At 4:19 AM, you can spot it rising in the northwest over Middleton near Verona High School before it travels toward the east over Fitchburg, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona has officially unveiled a new public art installation called Tai Chi Animal Frolics at Century School. This sculpture, created by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland, was commissioned by Gerri Gurman to bring more art into our community spaces.

There is plenty to do in our area. You can attend a yoga class at Insight Wellness today or participate in trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or check out the musical offerings at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
For our weekly report, the Verona Police Department noted that one week ago, officers were called to manage a car versus parked car crash within the city.
Today's flavor at Culver's of Verona is Snickers Swirl. The restaurant is currently closed but will open its doors today at 10:00 AM, allowing you to stop by for a sweet treat throughout the day.
